5. Discussion
COVID-19 has exacerbated individuals’ mental health [6–13] and consequently
heightened interest in mindfulness as a solution to mental illness problems [19–22]. Alt-
hough previous studies have identified certain strategies to promote mindfulness through
architecture, related studies remain limited [41–44]. However, since mindfulness is a mul-
tidimensional construct [45–47], promoting mindfulness indirectly through attention may
be feasible. Attention serves as the pivotal component and a central vehicle of mindfulness
[59–62], with the potential to support mental health [67–74]. While architecture can pro-
